references.text: The tribe of Gad is also mentioned here in connection with the census, where Eliasaph, son of Deuel, was the leader of the tribe.
The tribe of Gad and its leadership are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement in the wilderness.
Eliasaph, son of Deuel, led the army of the tribe of Gad during the journey through the wilderness.
The context for the selection of the spies, including Geuel from the tribe of Gad, who were sent to explore the land of Canaan.
Gad was a son of Jacob and Zilpah, and the ancestor of the tribe of Gad to which Geuel belonged.
